sequence_points.name: Abstract Cityscape with Reflections
sequence_points.description: An abstract painting depicting a city skyline with tall buildings rendered in warm browns, oranges, and muted blues, reflected in a shimmering water surface below. The composition uses vertical brushstrokes and blended colors to evoke an urban scene at dusk or dawn.

sequence_points.name: Winter Forest with Deer
sequence_points.description: A watercolor-style painting depicting a serene winter forest scene with tall, slender trees and two deer standing in the snow-covered clearing. The composition uses muted blues, grays, and whites with subtle golden accents in the background, creating a tranquil atmosphere.
